usedFor: WhautoChat holds your chat contacts and HubSpot your CRM, so “When a new contact is created” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new contact is created” in WhautoChat, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: New chat contacts reach HubSpot as records your sales team can work.

watchOut: “When a new contact is created” is polling, and “Create Contact” requires an email.
